newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Gulf War allies to hold naval exercises off Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Gulf War allies to hold naval exercises off Kuwait.

text.p: A French frigate arrived in Kuwait on Saturday to take part in exercises with the United States, Britain and Kuwait.

The French embassy said the F 70 class George Leygues, armed with two torpedo launchers and two helicopters, would join in the exercise by the Western powers which led the 1991 Gulf War to end a seven-month Iraqi occupation of Kuwait.
Iran, the oil-rich Gulf's non-Arab power and the only regional state to deploy submarines, on Friday ended its largest Gulf wargames in the southern end of the waterway.
